decision_scope: placement and operational readiness only; not launch authorization, scientific validity, or performance

accepted_input_identity.identity_qualification: hashes are accepted metadata bindings, not fresh H5 payload verification

required_source_and_boundary.boundary: accepted Arm-A remapped int16 voltage after accepted Kilosort per-channel centering, global median CAR, 300 Hz FFT high-pass, disabled artifact gate, and before whitening
required_source_and_boundary.hard_gate: freeze and review the actual H5 lazy wrapper; bind request chunk length, padding/overlap, crop, channel order, geometry, scaling, centering/CAR/filter/artifact order and transition context; pass predeclared ordinary and transition real-window sample equality before launch
required_source_and_boundary.full_effective_config_state: NOT_FROZEN; separate run contract must freeze every consumed setting, seed, training sample schedule and output schema

placement_roles.input: read-only accepted H5-local Arm-A binary at the exact accepted path
placement_roles.persistent_run_root: one new exact H5-local writable directory on a named filesystem; must be absent before launch and remain independent of chat or SSH lifetime
placement_roles.output: persistent_run_root/output; final sorting and stage outputs
placement_roles.scratch: persistent_run_root/scratch; attempt-specific temporary stage data only
placement_roles.cache: persistent_run_root/cache; explicit Numba/Torch/DARTsort caches, never an ambient or fixture-populated cache
placement_roles.failure_retention: persistent_run_root/failures; immutable quarantined partial stages and manager terminal receipts
placement_roles.logs_receipts: persistent_run_root/receipts; launch command, effective config, cgroup state, stdout/stderr, monitoring, terminal exit and provenance
placement_roles.shared_publication: compact manifests, reports, settings, logs and receipts only after validation; no voltage or large scratch/cache publication
placement_roles.same_filesystem_rule: output, scratch, cache and failure_retention must resolve to the same named local run filesystem whose free-space accounting is recorded; input may be on another H5-local filesystem

aggregate_cap_includes: filesystem-visible temporary files under the run root
storage_envelope.derivation: 482618717184 aggregate run-write cap plus 120000000000 emergency reserve; this is a conservative placement gate, not an estimate that the run will consume the cap
monitor_stop_conditions: sum of allocated bytes under persistent_run_root exceeds 482618717184
free bytes on the bound run filesystem fall below 120000000000
writes escape persistent_run_root or resolve to a different filesystem
storage_envelope.stop_behavior: stop the managed process group, preserve the attempt and terminal evidence, do not delete or retry, and report the exact breached condition

checkpoint_and_failure_policy.allowed_restart: fresh whole-peel-stage recomputation in a distinct validated namespace from unchanged upstream bindings
checkpoint_and_failure_policy.reuse_rule: reuse only completed stages whose exact inputs, source, configuration and manifest hashes remain valid
checkpoint_and_failure_policy.partial_rule: quarantine partial or manager-killed stages; never reopen them through stock automatic resume
checkpoint_and_failure_policy.interruption_disclosure: an interruption of an incomplete peel stage loses that stage and requires whole-stage restart; this is not within-stage resumability
checkpoint_and_failure_policy.retry_rule: no automatic restart; any new attempt requires terminal investigation and a new explicit dispatch

fresh_h5_checks.pass: accepted metadata packets rehash exactly; the exact path is a readable regular file of 241309358592 bytes; a fresh full-file SHA-256 equals 672938e942d105af6b1a3f7f1bddf206939535e0e4b57bc01153472a1ccb8b69
fresh_h5_checks.fail: block; do not substitute another path or reconstruct silently

fresh_h5_checks.pass: immutable reviewed wrapper/source/config packet exists and the actual H5 producer-consumer path passes predeclared ordinary and transition padded-window equality with channel, geometry, gain, clock and state-switch checks
actual H5 interpreter, executable hash, lock/environment, imported module paths and source hashes are frozen; DARTsort tree is clean at the required commit; actual imports match the frozen files
fresh_h5_checks.fail: block; an installed version string alone is insufficient

fresh_h5_checks.pass: full effective DARTsort config, seed, full-session training schedule, clock/origin, stage output schema and lineage members are frozen; config consumes preprocessing=none, copy_recording_to_tmpdir=no and work_in_tmpdir=false
fresh_h5_checks.fail: block; no full effective config is currently frozen

fresh_h5_checks.pass: exact new run root is absent, writable and nonsymlinked; role subpaths resolve beneath it; all write roles share the recorded local filesystem; the input remains read-only; no full float32 destination is configured

fresh statvfs on the bound run filesystem reports at least 602618717184 free bytes before any attempt creation; the aggregate write-cap and 120000000000-byte reserve monitors are installed and exercised by a cheap fixture
fresh_h5_checks.fail: block or freeze a separately reviewed smaller evidence-based envelope; do not waive the reserve ad hoc

fresh_h5_checks.pass: the separate run contract freezes MemoryMax from representative operational evidence; fresh MemAvailable is at least MemoryMax plus max(34359738368, 25% of MemoryMax); parent and leaf oomd/memory-pressure policy, swap limit and effective memory.max are recorded; no sustained pressure or recent unresolved oomd condition is present
fresh_h5_checks.fail: block; available-memory arithmetic alone does not clear oomd risk

fresh_h5_checks.pass: the exact H5 runtime sees the frozen GPU UUID, performs a tiny CUDA allocation, has enough free device memory for the frozen envelope, and no other spike sort or unowned compute process occupies the selected GPU
fresh_h5_checks.fail: block; candidate 2 and candidate 3 must not share an occupied GPU

fresh_h5_checks.pass: persistent manager survives launcher disconnection; exact unit/command/environment are frozen; Restart=no, KillMode=control-group, TasksMax, MemoryMax, swap policy, wall limit and terminal finalizer are effective in the live leaf cgroup; CPU policy is explicitly bounded with kernel proof or explicitly unbounded; normal, failure, timeout, oomd/cgroup kill and user-stop terminal receipts are preserved
fresh_h5_checks.fail: block; declarative properties without effective cgroup evidence are insufficient

fresh_h5_checks.pass: exact service, timer, process, run root and output namespace are absent; no candidate-2 or other full sort is active; stale failed namespaces remain preserved and are not reused
fresh_h5_checks.fail: block without stopping an unrelated job

fresh_h5_checks.pass: actual runner disables trust in partial peel resume, uses fresh whole-stage attempt namespaces, validates completed-stage reuse, and retains a failure-injection receipt through the installed entrypoint

launch and terminal receipt destinations are persistent and writable before start; stop conditions and no-retry rule are frozen; compact publication excludes raw voltage and large caches; COMPLETE is written last

required_saved_provenance: exact launch command and installed service bytes
training sample times, state coverage and randomness
construction memberships and event/parent source-row identities
extraction, matching and final times with each realignment transformation
template-to-unit lineage, stage banks and fitted models
periodic storage, host memory, cgroup memory and GPU telemetry
terminal manager properties and final exit status
invalidation_conditions: accepted input path, size, hashes, clock, channel order, geometry, gain or support changes
wrapper, Kilosort boundary source/order, DARTsort commit/imports or effective config changes after review
run-root mount, filesystem identity, free space or write-role placement changes
memory, oomd, swap, GPU, CPU, pids, wall-time or manager policy differs from the frozen effective state
another full sort starts on H5 or the selected GPU becomes occupied
checkpoint/restart or failure-retention behavior differs from the reviewed runner
any listed fresh check is stale at launch time
current_blockers: lazy context-correct prewhitening wrapper is absent and real ordinary/transition equality is unproven
full effective candidate-3 configuration and H5 runtime bindings are not frozen
exact H5 run root/filesystem and current capacity are unbound
current H5 memory/oomd, GPU, process/service and effective-manager state are unverified
release_rule: All H5-01 through H5-12 must pass against one immutable run contract immediately before exactly one coordinator-dispatched launch. This specification alone does not authorize or start the run.
